title: Ostrich EYES are BIGGER than their BRAIN?! 👀 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. thinks his big brain knows everything… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: An ostrich's eye (about 5 cm across, among the largest of any land animal) is bigger than its brain.
Some vultures and storks (e.g. turkey vultures) pee on their own legs to cool down on hot days; the evaporating liquid cools them (urohidrosis).
Honeybees do a 'waggle dance' in the hive that tells other bees the direction and distance to flowers (Karl von Frisch, Nobel Prize 1973).
